title: Ratio and proportion: practice set
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: ₹1,200 is divided between Asha and Bina in the ratio 3 : 5. How much does Bina get?
The ratio of boys to girls in a school group is 7 : 5. There are 84 students in all. How many are girls?
8 workers can dig a trench in 15 days. Working at the same rate, how many days will 12 workers take?
a : b = 2 : 3 and b : c = 4 : 5. If c = 45, find a.
The present ages of Meena and Neha are in the ratio 5 : 7. Six years ago their ages were in the ratio 2 : 3. What is the sum of their present ages (in years)?
Arun puts in ₹40,000 for the whole year. Bhanu puts in ₹50,000 for 8 months. A profit of ₹13,200 is shared in proportion to investment × time. How much does Bhanu get (in ₹)?
The cost of a pipe varies directly with its length. A pipe of 7.5 m costs ₹450. What is the cost of an 11 m pipe?
The ratio of red to blue marbles in a bag is 3 : 4. When 12 more red marbles are added, the ratio of red to blue becomes 5 : 4. How many marbles were in the bag originally?
The incomes of Gopal and Hari are in the ratio 5 : 4 and their expenditures are in the ratio 3 : 2. Each saves ₹1,600. What is Gopal's income?
₹4,600 is divided among A, B and C. A's share to B's share is 2 : 3, and B's share to C's share is 5 : 7. How much more does C get than A (in ₹)?
